about.title: About Us
about.intro: At our clinic in Kayaşehir, Istanbul, our aim is to provide high-quality healthcare and a calm, well-equipped environment that frees our patients from the fear of the dentist.
paragraphs: At our clinic we follow the philosophy of “maximum patient comfort with minimum procedures”. Unlike busy clinics that work like a production line, we offer personalised treatment with an eye for aesthetics. Our goal is to be your family's dentist.

We believe that learning should continue throughout life; we follow current knowledge and technology and apply it in our patients' treatments. We provide care in every branch of modern dentistry, particularly aesthetic dentistry, implantology, orthodontics and paediatric dentistry.

The staff who assist our dentists also receive regular training in their fields and keep up with developments. Sterilisation and infection control is the first rule we never compromise on in our clinic.

treatments.name: Dental Implants
treatments.short: The permanent solution closest to a natural tooth for missing teeth. Single, multiple and implant-supported prostheses.
treatments.meta_title: Dental Implants in Kayaşehir, Istanbul | Başakşehir Dentist
treatments.meta_description: Dental implants in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir: who is suitable, how long it takes, is it painful? Call Ay Yıldız Dental Clinic for a implant consultation.
treatments.intro: A dental implant is a titanium screw placed in the jawbone to replace a lost tooth, imitating the root of a natural tooth. A porcelain or zirconia crown on top gives the look and biting strength closest to a natural tooth. Because neighbouring teeth are left untouched, it is today the best option for a missing tooth.

sections.title: Who can have a dental implant?
items: Adults who are missing one or more teeth
Patients with no teeth who are unhappy with removable dentures (implant-supported fixed prosthesis)
Patients with sufficient jawbone, or whose bone can be built up to a sufficient level
Patients whose gum health is under control

sections.title: How does the treatment proceed?
items: Consultation and X-ray assessment; bone volume and general health are examined.
The implant is placed in the jawbone under local anaesthesia. The procedure takes 20–40 minutes and is no more painful than a tooth extraction.
A 2–3 month period of bonding with the bone (osseointegration). A temporary tooth can be worn during this time.
An impression is taken and the permanent porcelain or zirconia crown is fitted on the implant.

sections.title: Benefits of implants
items: Neighbouring healthy teeth are not cut down.
Chewing strength and speech come closest to those of natural teeth.
Prevents the jawbone from shrinking.
Can last a lifetime with regular care.

sections.title: Aftercare for implants
sections.text: Cold compresses and soft food are recommended on the first day. Smoking delays healing. Brushing twice a day, using interdental brushes and having a check-up every 6 months are the most important factors in how long your implant lasts.

faq.q: Is dental implant treatment painful?
faq.a: No. Implants are placed under local anaesthesia, so you feel no pain during the procedure. There may be mild tenderness for 1–2 days afterwards, which passes easily with a painkiller.

faq.q: How long does implant treatment take?
faq.a: Placing the implant takes 20–40 minutes. You then wait 2–3 months for it to bond with the bone, after which the permanent tooth is fitted. In suitable cases a temporary tooth can be made on the same day.

faq.q: Can I have an implant if my bone is insufficient?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. The bone volume can be increased with procedures such as bone grafting or sinus lifting before the implant is placed. This is assessed with an X-ray at the check-up.

faq.q: How long does an implant last?
faq.a: With good oral hygiene and regular check-ups, an implant can last a lifetime. The crown on top may need renewing after 10–15 years.

faq.q: What determines the price of an implant?
faq.a: The implant brand used, the type of crown (porcelain or zirconia), whether bone grafting is needed and the number of implants all affect the price. A clear plan and price are given at the check-up.

treatments.name: Smile Design
treatments.short: A combination of veneers, zirconia and whitening planned around your facial features, age and lip structure.
treatments.meta_title: Smile Design in Kayaşehir | Cosmetic Dentist Başakşehir
treatments.meta_description: Smile design in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir, Istanbul: veneers, zirconia, whitening and gum aesthetics tailored to your face. Assessment.
treatments.intro: Smile design combines dentistry and artistry to plan the ideal smile for you. Your facial features, gender, age, lip and gum structure, and the alignment and colour of your teeth are all assessed together; the result is not artificial, but a smile that is truly yours.

sections.title: What is assessed in smile design?
items: Facial features and smile symmetry
Tooth shape suited to age and gender
Alignment, length and colour of the teeth
Lip line and gum visibility
Jaw relationship and chewing function

sections.title: Which treatments are used?
items: Porcelain veneers
Zirconia crowns
Teeth whitening
Minor corrections with composite bonding
Gum contouring (pink aesthetics)
Preparatory orthodontics if needed

sections.title: How does the treatment proceed?
items: Consultation, photographs and X-ray analysis.
The new smile is designed digitally or on a wax model; a temporary trial (mock-up) is available on request.
After your approval, minimal preparation of the teeth and the laboratory stage.
Permanent restorations are bonded in place and checked. About 7–14 days on average.

faq.q: How many appointments does smile design take?
faq.a: Usually 2–4 appointments over a total of 1–2 weeks. It takes longer if orthodontics or gum treatment is needed.

faq.q: Does smile design damage the teeth?
faq.a: Very little tooth material is removed for veneers and bonding, and in some cases none at all. When properly planned, it does not harm the tooth.

faq.q: How long do the results last?
faq.a: Porcelain veneers and zirconia restorations last 10–15 years or more with good care. The effect of whitening lasts 1–3 years.

faq.q: Can I see the result beforehand?
faq.a: Yes. With a digital design and an in-mouth mock-up you can try your new smile before any permanent work begins.

treatments.name: Porcelain Veneers
treatments.short: A lasting aesthetic solution for colour, shape and spacing problems in the front teeth, using very thin porcelain shells.
treatments.meta_title: Porcelain Veneers in Kayaşehir | Dental Veneers Başakşehir
treatments.meta_description: Porcelain veneers in Kayaşehir, Istanbul: a minimal-preparation solution for discolouration, gaps, chips and crowding. Ay Yıldız Dental Clinic, Başakşehir.
treatments.intro: Veneers are porcelain layers, 0.3–0.7 mm thick, bonded to the front surface of front teeth with aesthetic problems. Very little tooth material is removed, and colour, shape and minor alignment problems are solved in one go.

sections.title: When are veneers used?
items: Discolouration that whitening cannot remove
Gaps between teeth (diastema)
Chipped, worn or short teeth
Replacing old, stained fillings
Mild crowding (for patients who do not want orthodontics)

sections.title: How does the treatment proceed?
items: Consultation, colour and shape planning.
A very thin layer is removed from the front of the teeth and an impression is taken.
Temporary veneers are fitted while your custom porcelain veneers are made in the laboratory.
The veneers are bonded with a special adhesive. Total 5–10 days.

sections.title: Benefits
items: The look closest to the light transmission of natural teeth
Resistant to staining and discolouration
Minimal preparation, tooth vitality is preserved
A lifespan of 10–15 years or more

faq.q: Veneers or zirconia?
faq.a: If there is no major loss of tooth structure or root canal treatment, veneers need less preparation and look more natural. Zirconia crowns are preferred for teeth with large fillings or severe crowding.

faq.q: Can veneers break?
faq.a: Once bonded, porcelain veneers become one with the tooth and withstand normal chewing forces. A night guard is recommended for people who clench or grind their teeth.

faq.q: Is getting veneers painful?
faq.a: The preparation is so superficial that anaesthesia is often not even needed; the procedure is painless.

treatments.name: Orthodontics (Braces and Clear Aligners)
treatments.short: Neatly aligned teeth for children and adults with metal or ceramic braces and clear aligners.
treatments.meta_title: Orthodontics in Kayaşehir | Braces & Clear Aligners Istanbul
treatments.meta_description: Orthodontics in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir: braces, ceramic brackets and clear aligners for children and adults. Orthodontic check-up from age 7.
treatments.h1: Orthodontics: Braces and Clear Aligners in Kayaşehir
treatments.intro: Orthodontics is the branch of dentistry that corrects misalignment of the teeth and jaws to give the patient good aesthetics, speech and chewing function. Crowded teeth affect not only appearance but also gum health, decay risk and the jaw joint.

sections.title: Who is orthodontic treatment for?
items: Patients of any age with crowded, gapped or rotated teeth
People with an upper and lower jaw mismatch (bite problems)
Early check-ups for children aged 7–10 and, if needed, jaw guidance
Patients whose teeth look straight but whose bite is off

sections.title: Treatment options
items: Metal brackets: the most economical and effective method
Ceramic (tooth-coloured) brackets: less visible
Clear aligners: removable and almost invisible; for suitable cases
Removable appliances: for children who are still growing

sections.title: Treatment process
items: Consultation, panoramic and cephalometric X-rays, model analysis.
Explanation of the treatment plan and options.
Fitting of brackets or aligners; check-ups every 4–8 weeks.
Treatment lasts from 6 months to 3 years, followed by a retention period.

faq.q: Is there an age limit for orthodontic treatment?
faq.a: No. As long as your teeth and gums are healthy, orthodontics can be done at any age. For children, a first check-up at around age 7 is recommended.

faq.q: Clear aligners or braces?
faq.a: Clear aligners offer invisibility and comfort and are ideal for mild to moderate cases. For serious bite problems, fixed brackets give stronger results. The right choice is decided at your consultation.

faq.q: Do braces hurt?
faq.a: For the first 2–3 days after fitting, and after each adjustment, you feel mild pressure; this is normal and passes quickly.

faq.q: Do the teeth go back once treatment is finished?
faq.a: They can if a retainer or fixed wire is not used. That is why the retention period after treatment is part of the treatment.

treatments.name: Paediatric Dentistry
treatments.short: Digital anaesthesia, preventive care and a fear-free first visit with a specialist paediatric dentist.
treatments.meta_title: Children's Dentist in Kayaşehir | Paediatric Dentistry Istanbul
treatments.meta_description: Children's dentist in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir: Dr. Vahide Ceyda Acar, paediatric dentist, for baby teeth, sealants, fluoride, crowns and digital anaesthesia.
treatments.intro: Paediatric dentistry is the speciality dedicated to protecting and treating the baby and permanent teeth of children aged 0–14. Our paediatric dentist makes the first visit feel like play, treats without hurting and wins the child's trust, preventing a lifelong fear of the dentist.

sections.title: Treatments we offer
items: Preventive care: fluoride varnish, fissure sealants
Fillings and pulp (pulpotomy) treatments in baby and permanent teeth
Paediatric (stainless steel and aesthetic) crowns
ICON treatment for white spots and SDF to arrest decay
Space maintainers
Pain-free treatment with digital anaesthesia
Treatment planning under general anaesthesia for children who cannot be treated in the clinic

sections.title: When should the first visit be?
sections.text: When the first baby tooth appears, and by age 1 at the latest. Meeting the dentist early prevents both decay and fear. An orthodontic check-up is recommended at around age 7.

sections.title: Advice for parents
items: Do not give milk or juice in a bottle at night (baby bottle decay).
From age 2, brush twice a day with fluoride children's toothpaste.
A check-up and fluoride application every 6 months.
Do not describe the dentist in a frightening way in front of your child.

faq.q: Baby teeth fall out anyway, is treatment necessary?
faq.a: Yes. A decayed baby tooth causes pain and abscesses and can damage the permanent tooth beneath it; if lost early, it leads to lack of space and crowding.

faq.q: My child is afraid of the dentist, what can we do?
faq.a: The first appointment is only for getting to know each other and play. With digital anaesthesia there is no sensation of a needle. If needed, we introduce treatment gradually.

faq.q: Is fluoride application safe?
faq.a: Yes. Professional fluoride varnish is a safe and effective way of preventing decay, recommended worldwide.

faq.q: Which children have dental treatment under general anaesthesia?
faq.a: It is planned in a hospital setting for very young children with many cavities, children who cannot cooperate in the clinic, or children with special needs.

treatments.name: Root Canal Treatment (Endodontics)
treatments.short: A treatment, usually completed in a single visit, that saves an infected or painful tooth from extraction.
treatments.meta_title: Root Canal Treatment in Kayaşehir | Endodontics Başakşehir
treatments.meta_description: Root canal treatment in Kayaşehir: why it is needed, how many visits, is it painful? Save your tooth from extraction at Ay Yıldız Dental Clinic, Başakşehir.
treatments.h1: Root Canal Treatment in Kayaşehir, Istanbul
treatments.intro: Root canal treatment is carried out to save a tooth from extraction when the nerve and blood vessel tissue inside it (the pulp) has become infected because of decay or trauma. The infected tissue is cleaned out, and the canals are disinfected and filled; the tooth stays in your mouth.

sections.title: When is root canal treatment needed?
items: Toothache that lingers after hot or cold, or comes on by itself
Throbbing pain that wakes you at night
Swelling or a pimple (abscess) on the gum
Darkening in the colour of the tooth
Nerve damage caused by deep decay or a fracture

sections.title: How does the treatment proceed?
items: The canal structure is assessed with an X-ray and local anaesthesia is given.
The decay is removed, the canals are reached and shaped with a rotary instrument system.
The canals are disinfected and sealed with a special filling material.
The tooth is restored with a filling or crown. One visit in most cases; 2–3 visits for abscessed teeth.

sections.title: After treatment
sections.text: Some tenderness when chewing for a few days is normal. Because a tooth that has had a root canal is more fragile, protection with a crown or onlay is recommended for back teeth.

faq.q: Is root canal treatment painful?
faq.a: No. It is done under local anaesthesia. The pain is usually there before the treatment, and the treatment removes it.

faq.q: How many visits does root canal treatment take?
faq.a: Most teeth are completed in a single visit (45–90 minutes). If there is an abscess or heavy infection, 2–3 visits may be needed.

faq.q: Do I need a crown after root canal treatment?
faq.a: For back teeth, yes; a tooth that has had a root canal is more fragile, and protecting it with a crown extends its life. For front teeth, a filling is often enough.

faq.q: Wouldn't it be better to just have the tooth pulled?
faq.a: Your own tooth is always the best option. After an extraction the gap needs an implant or bridge; root canal treatment is more economical and more natural.

treatments.name: Dental Fillings
treatments.short: Decay is removed and the tooth repaired in one visit with a tooth-coloured composite. Aesthetic and durable.
treatments.meta_title: Dental Fillings in Kayaşehir | White Fillings Başakşehir
treatments.meta_description: Dental fillings in Kayaşehir: white composite fillings, porcelain inlays and onlays, sensitivity after fillings and filling lifespan. Ay Yıldız Dental, Başakşehir.
treatments.intro: A filling replaces tooth structure lost to decay or fracture, restoring the shape and function of the tooth. Tooth-coloured composite fillings are done in a single visit and are aesthetically unnoticeable.

sections.title: Types of fillings
items: Composite (white) filling: single visit, aesthetic, bonds to the tooth
Inlay-onlay (porcelain) filling: a durable restoration made in the laboratory for large areas of lost tooth structure
Composite bonding: closing chips and gaps in front teeth

sections.title: How does the treatment proceed?
items: The depth of the decay is determined with an examination and X-ray.
Local anaesthesia if needed; the decay is removed completely.
The composite is placed in layers and hardened with light.
Bite check and polishing. Total 30–45 minutes.

sections.title: After a filling
sections.text: Do not eat until the anaesthetic has worn off. Sensitivity to cold is normal in the first few days. Brush the filled tooth as usual; avoid biting hard objects.

faq.q: How long do white fillings last?
faq.a: On average 7–10 years with regular care. The size and position of the filling and any clenching habit affect its lifespan.

faq.q: White filling or amalgam (silver) filling?
faq.a: Composite fillings are aesthetic, bond to the tooth to strengthen it and require less tooth material to be removed. That is why they are the preferred option today.

faq.q: Is pain normal after a filling?
faq.a: Sensitivity to hot and cold can last from a few days to a few weeks. If it hurts when you bite, the filling may be high; a quick adjustment solves it.

faq.q: Can I have a filling during pregnancy?
faq.a: Yes. It is done safely, especially in the second trimester; leaving a painful, infected tooth untreated is riskier.

treatments.name: Gum Disease Treatment and Teeth Cleaning
treatments.short: Treatment of tartar and inflammation, the most common causes of bleeding gums, gum recession and bad breath.
treatments.meta_title: Gum Treatment & Teeth Cleaning in Kayaşehir | Başakşehir
treatments.meta_description: Bleeding gums and scale and polish in Kayaşehir, Istanbul: gingivitis, periodontitis, deep cleaning and maintenance care at Ay Yıldız Dental, Başakşehir.
treatments.h1: Gum Disease Treatment and Teeth Cleaning in Kayaşehir
treatments.intro: Plaque and tartar building up on the teeth are the most common cause of bleeding and red gums and bad breath. Untreated gum inflammation (gingivitis) progresses to bone loss and loose teeth (periodontitis). In the early stage it can be completely reversed with a simple cleaning.

sections.title: Symptoms
items: Gums that bleed when brushing or on their own
Red, swollen or tender gums
Receding gums and teeth that look longer
Persistent bad breath
Loose or spreading teeth

sections.title: Treatment options
items: Scale and polish (scaling): with an ultrasonic device, 30–45 minutes, painless
Root surface planing (deep cleaning): removing tartar below the gum line, under anaesthesia
Gum surgery: flap surgery and bone reshaping in advanced cases
Gum aesthetics: correcting a gummy smile and gum recession

sections.title: Prevention
items: Brush for 2 minutes, twice a day
Floss or use interdental brushes every day
A check-up and cleaning every 6 months
Quit smoking

faq.q: Why do gums bleed, and is it dangerous?
faq.a: The most common cause is gum inflammation brought on by plaque and tartar. In the early stage it is not dangerous and clears up in 1–2 weeks with a cleaning; if neglected, it progresses to bone loss and tooth loss.

faq.q: Does teeth cleaning damage the teeth?
faq.a: No. Ultrasonic cleaning only removes the tartar and does not harm the enamel. The gaps you feel after cleaning are simply the spaces the tartar had been filling.

faq.q: How often should teeth be cleaned?
faq.a: Every 6 months for most people; every 3–4 months if you have a history of gum disease, smoke or have diabetes.

faq.q: Does gum recession grow back?
faq.a: Receded gums do not grow back on their own, but the progression can be stopped and, in suitable cases, they can be covered with a gum graft.

faq.q: Should I use dental floss?
faq.a: Yes. A toothbrush cleans only about 60% of tooth surfaces; floss or interdental brushes are essential for the spaces in between.

treatments.name: Teeth Whitening
treatments.short: Several shades whiter teeth with single-visit in-office whitening and home whitening with trays.
treatments.meta_title: Teeth Whitening in Kayaşehir | Professional Whitening Istanbul
treatments.meta_description: Teeth whitening in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir: in-office single-visit and home whitening, how long it lasts, sensitivity and safety. Ay Yıldız Dental Clinic.
treatments.intro: Teeth whitening lightens stains that have penetrated the enamel and dentine using special gels. When carried out under a dentist's supervision it is safe and lightens teeth by several shades in a single visit.

sections.title: Whitening methods
items: In-office: 45–60 minutes at the clinic, light-assisted, instant results
At-home: custom trays and gel used at home for 1–2 weeks
Combined: both together for the longest-lasting result
Single-tooth whitening: internal whitening for darkened teeth that have had root canal treatment

sections.title: Before whitening
sections.text: A scale and polish is done first and any decay is treated. Fillings, crowns and veneers do not whiten; they are renewed after the procedure if necessary.

sections.title: Afterwards and how long it lasts
sections.text: For the first 48 hours avoid tea, coffee, smoking and strongly coloured foods. The effect lasts 1–3 years depending on your habits and is easily refreshed with home trays.

faq.q: Does teeth whitening damage the teeth?
faq.a: When carried out under a dentist's supervision at the right concentration, it does not harm the enamel. Temporary sensitivity can occur and passes within 1–2 days.

faq.q: How many shades whiter will my teeth get?
faq.a: Usually 2–4 shades. Yellowish stains respond better than grey-brown stains.

faq.q: Who should not have whitening?
faq.a: It is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women, people under 16, people with untreated decay or gum disease, and people with severe enamel sensitivity.

treatments.name: Dental Crowns, Zirconia and Prosthetics
treatments.short: Restoring chewing and aesthetics with zirconia and porcelain crowns, bridges, implant-supported and removable dentures.
treatments.meta_title: Zirconia Crowns & Dentures in Kayaşehir | Başakşehir
treatments.meta_description: Zirconia crowns, porcelain crowns, bridges, implant-supported and removable dentures in Kayaşehir, Istanbul. Personalised prosthetic care at Ay Yıldız Dental.
treatments.h1: Dental Crowns, Zirconia and Prosthetics in Kayaşehir
treatments.intro: Prosthetic dentistry restores function and aesthetics for missing or badly damaged teeth with crowns, bridges, implant-supported prostheses or removable dentures. Metal-free zirconia crowns offer a natural tooth appearance and high durability.

sections.title: Prosthetic options
items: Zirconia crown: metal-free, causes no darkening at the gum line, natural light transmission
Porcelain (metal-supported) crown: economical and durable
Bridge: a fixed prosthesis that takes support from the teeth either side of the missing tooth
Fixed or removable implant-supported prostheses
Complete and partial removable dentures
Night guard: protection against clenching and grinding

sections.title: How does the treatment proceed?
items: Consultation and planning; shade selection.
Preparation of the teeth and a digital or conventional impression.
A temporary crown during the laboratory stage (5–7 days).
Try-in, bite check and permanent cementation.

faq.q: How long do zirconia crowns last?
faq.a: 10–15 years or more with good care. Regular check-ups and flossing prevent decay at the margins.

faq.q: Zirconia or porcelain?
faq.a: Zirconia contains no metal, so it is more aesthetic and does not darken at the gum margin; it is especially preferred for front teeth. Both work well for back teeth.

faq.q: Is a lot of tooth removed for a crown?
faq.a: About 1–1.5 mm of tooth is removed for zirconia. The vitality of the tooth is mostly preserved.

treatments.name: Tooth Extraction and Impacted Wisdom Teeth
treatments.short: Pain-free removal of teeth that cannot be saved, and impacted wisdom tooth surgery.
treatments.meta_title: Tooth Extraction & Wisdom Teeth in Kayaşehir | Istanbul
treatments.meta_description: Pain-free tooth extraction and impacted wisdom tooth removal in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir: when it is needed, healing and aftercare. Ay Yıldız Dental Clinic.
treatments.h1: Tooth Extraction and Impacted Wisdom Teeth in Kayaşehir
treatments.intro: Tooth extraction is the last option for teeth that cannot be saved by fillings, root canal treatment or crowns. Wisdom teeth often do not fit in the jaw and stay impacted; they may need to be removed because of pain, decay in the neighbouring tooth and the risk of cysts.

sections.title: When is extraction needed?
items: Teeth that cannot be restored because of severe decay or fracture
Loose teeth caused by advanced gum disease
Impacted or partially impacted wisdom teeth
Making space for orthodontic treatment
Baby teeth that do not fall out

sections.title: How is the procedure done?
items: The root structure and closeness to the nerve are assessed with an X-ray.
Local anaesthesia; you feel no pain during the procedure, only a sensation of pressure.
A simple extraction takes 10–20 minutes; impacted tooth surgery 30–60 minutes.
Stitches are placed if needed and removed after 7–10 days.

sections.title: Aftercare for extraction
items: Bite on the gauze for 30–45 minutes; do not spit or rinse.
On the first day avoid hot food, smoking and straws.
Apply a cold pack to the outside of the face; from day 2, rinse gently with warm salty water.
Take your painkiller as your dentist advises.

faq.q: Can't I just take antibiotics instead of having the tooth pulled?
faq.a: Antibiotics only suppress the infection temporarily; if the tooth that is the source is not treated, the abscess comes back. Antibiotics are given to support treatment when they are needed.

faq.q: Does every wisdom tooth have to be removed?
faq.a: No. Wisdom teeth that have erupted properly, can be cleaned and cause no problems may stay in the mouth. Teeth that are impacted, painful or causing decay in the neighbouring tooth are removed.

faq.q: How long does healing take after extraction?
faq.a: You are fully back to daily life in 3–5 days after a simple extraction and 7–10 days after impacted tooth surgery. Swelling is greatest on days 2–3 and then goes down.

faq.q: What should be done to replace the extracted tooth?
faq.a: For missing teeth other than wisdom teeth, the gap lets neighbouring teeth tilt. Replacing the tooth with an implant or bridge within 2–3 months is recommended.

faq.meta_title: Dental FAQ | Bleeding Gums, Fillings, Implants – Kayaşehir
faq.meta_description: Frequently asked questions answered by Ay Yıldız Dental Clinic dentists in Kayaşehir, Istanbul: bleeding gums, fillings, implants, root canals, extractions, children's teeth, braces.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Our dentists have answered the questions our patients ask most, briefly and clearly. If you cannot find the answer to your question, message us on WhatsApp; we reply the same day.

items.q: How can I book an appointment?
items.a: You can call 0212 931 99 32 or 0530 391 99 32, or message us on WhatsApp. Requests received outside working hours are answered on the next working day.

items.q: Where is your clinic?
items.a: We are in Kayaşehir, Başakşehir, at Seyranşehir Site, D3 Block, No 15C, on Kayaşehir Boulevard. It is within walking distance of the Kayaşehir Merkez metro station.

items.q: Which languages do you offer service in?
items.a: Turkish, English and Arabic. Our website is also available in three languages.

items.q: What are the payment options?
items.a: We accept cash and credit cards; for longer treatments, instalment options are shared at the check-up. We also help you find out whether your private health insurance covers dental care.

items.q: How often should I see the dentist?
items.a: Even if you have no complaints, a check-up and cleaning every 6 months is recommended. Decay caught early is solved with a small filling, whereas decay found late needs a root canal or extraction.

items.q: Why do gums bleed, and is it dangerous?
items.a: The most common cause is gum inflammation (gingivitis) brought on by plaque and tartar. In the early stage it clears up in 1–2 weeks with a cleaning and good brushing. If neglected, it progresses to bone loss and tooth loss (periodontitis).

items.q: Should I stop brushing if my gums bleed?
items.a: No, quite the opposite. Cleaning the bleeding area more carefully with a soft brush and using floss reduces the inflammation. If the bleeding does not stop within 2 weeks, see a dentist.

items.q: Does teeth cleaning wear down the teeth?
items.a: No. Ultrasonic cleaning only removes the tartar and does not harm the enamel. The spaces you feel between your teeth afterwards are simply where the tartar used to be.

items.q: How often should tartar be cleaned?
items.a: Every 6 months for most people; every 3–4 months if you have a history of gum disease, smoke or have diabetes.

items.q: What causes bad breath?
items.a: Most often tartar, gum inflammation, cavities and the bacterial coating on the tongue. Cleaning and tongue brushing largely resolve it. If it persists, stomach or sinus causes are investigated.

items.q: Does gum recession grow back?
items.a: Receded gums do not grow back on their own, but the progression can be stopped and, in suitable cases, they can be covered with a gum graft.

items.q: How long do white fillings last?
items.a: On average 7–10 years with regular care. The size and position of the filling and any clenching habit affect its lifespan.

items.q: White or black (amalgam) fillings?
items.a: Composite white fillings are aesthetic, bond to the tooth to strengthen it and require less tooth material to be removed. They are the preferred option today.

items.q: Is sensitivity after a filling normal?
items.a: Sensitivity to hot and cold can last from a few days to a few weeks. If it hurts when you bite, the filling may be high; a quick adjustment solves it.

items.q: Does getting a filling hurt?
items.a: For deep cavities, local anaesthesia is given and the procedure is painless. For shallow cavities, anaesthesia may not even be needed.

items.q: Can I have a filling during pregnancy?
items.a: Yes, it is done safely, especially in the second trimester. Leaving a painful, infected tooth untreated is riskier for both mother and baby.

items.q: Should my old filling be replaced?
items.a: If there is decay, a fracture or leakage at its edge, yes. A sound, non-leaking filling does not have to be replaced just because of its colour.

items.q: Is dental implant treatment painful?
items.a: No. It is done under local anaesthesia and you feel no pain during the procedure. There may be mild tenderness for 1–2 days afterwards.

items.q: How long does an implant take?
items.a: Placement takes 20–40 minutes. You then wait 2–3 months for bonding with the bone, after which the permanent tooth is fitted. In suitable cases a temporary tooth can be made on the same day.

items.q: Can I have an implant if my bone is insufficient?
items.a: In most cases, yes. The bone volume can be increased with bone grafting or sinus lifting. It is assessed with an X-ray at the check-up.

items.q: How long does an implant last?
items.a: With good hygiene and regular check-ups, it can last a lifetime. The crown on top may need renewing after 10–15 years.

items.q: Who cannot have implants?
items.a: Risk is assessed in people with uncontrolled diabetes, young people whose bone growth is not complete (under 18), those taking strong osteoporosis medication and heavy smokers; in most cases implants can still be done once suitable conditions are met.

items.q: Implant or bridge?
items.a: An implant does not require cutting down neighbouring teeth and preserves the bone; it is more economical in the long term. If the neighbouring teeth already need crowns, a bridge is also a good option.

items.q: Why is root canal treatment necessary?
items.a: When decay or trauma reaches the nerve of the tooth, infection begins; if this tissue is not cleaned out, an abscess and bone loss develop. Root canal treatment saves the tooth from extraction.

items.q: How many visits does root canal treatment take?
items.a: Most teeth are completed in a single visit (45–90 minutes). If there is an abscess, 2–3 visits may be needed.

items.q: Do I need a crown after root canal treatment?
items.a: For back teeth, yes; a tooth that has had a root canal is more fragile. For front teeth, a filling is often enough.

items.q: How does a tooth abscess form?
items.a: It forms when bacteria collect at the root tip or in the gum as a result of untreated deep decay or gum disease. It can cause swelling, throbbing pain and fever, and needs urgent treatment.

items.q: What does toothache at night mean?
items.a: Throbbing pain that gets worse when you lie down usually means the nerve is inflamed and root canal treatment is needed. A painkiller is only a temporary solution; see a dentist as soon as possible.

items.q: Does a tooth with a root canal last a lifetime?
items.a: Yes, when properly restored and looked after; many root-filled teeth are used for decades.

items.q: What is an impacted tooth, and does it need to be removed?
items.a: A tooth that has not been able to erupt within the jaw is called impacted; wisdom teeth are the most common. If it causes pain, decay in the neighbouring tooth, a cyst or an orthodontic problem it is removed; a tooth that causes no problem can be monitored.

items.q: Can't I just take antibiotics instead of having the tooth pulled?
items.a: Antibiotics suppress the infection temporarily; if the source is not treated, the abscess comes back. Antibiotics are given to support treatment when they are needed.

items.q: What should I watch out for after an extraction?
items.a: Bite on the gauze for 30–45 minutes, do not spit or rinse on the first day, and do not smoke or use a straw. Apply a cold pack to the outside to reduce swelling.

items.q: How long does pain last after an extraction?
items.a: 1–2 days after a simple extraction and 3–5 days after impacted tooth surgery. Pain that gets worse after day 3 may be a sign of dry socket (alveolitis); contact the clinic.

items.q: At what age should I first take my child to the dentist?
items.a: When the first baby tooth appears, and by age 1 at the latest. Meeting the dentist early prevents both decay and fear of the dentist.

items.q: Should decay in baby teeth be treated?
items.a: Yes. A decayed baby tooth causes pain and abscesses and can damage the permanent tooth beneath it; losing it early causes crowding.

items.q: What is baby bottle decay?
items.a: It is decay that develops rapidly in the front teeth of babies who have milk or juice in a bottle at night. It is prevented by giving only water at night and wiping the teeth.

items.q: Is fluoride treatment safe for children?
items.a: Yes. Professional fluoride varnish is a safe and effective way of preventing decay, recommended worldwide.

items.q: What is a fissure sealant?
items.a: It is a protective coating applied to the deep grooves of the molars; it greatly reduces the risk of decay. It is applied when the 6-year and 12-year molars erupt.

items.q: My child's teeth are crowded, when should we see an orthodontist?
items.a: A first orthodontic check-up is recommended at around age 7. Guiding jaw growth early can reduce the need for braces later.

items.q: Does teeth whitening damage the teeth?
items.a: When carried out under a dentist's supervision it does not harm the enamel. Temporary sensitivity passes within 1–2 days. The effect lasts 1–3 years.

items.q: Veneers or zirconia?
items.a: If there is no major loss of tooth structure, veneers need less preparation and look more natural. Zirconia is preferred for teeth with large fillings or root canal treatment.

items.q: Clear aligners or braces?
items.a: Clear aligners are invisible and comfortable and are ideal for mild to moderate cases. For serious bite problems, fixed brackets give stronger results.

items.q: Is there an age limit for orthodontics?
items.a: No. It can be done at any age as long as your teeth and gums are healthy.

items.q: What can be done for teeth clenching (bruxism)?
items.a: A night guard protects the teeth from wear; where needed, jaw muscle relaxing treatments and bite adjustment are carried out.

items.q: Should I see a dentist for jaw joint pain?
items.a: Yes. Clicking, pain or locking in the jaw joint can come from clenching, a bite problem or missing teeth; the cause is determined by an examination.
